examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Tab Bar Layout Mode
examples.description: This example shows how to use barMode to implement two tab bar layouts: equal-width tab layout and actual-length-based layout. It also shows the scrollable effect when the combined width of tabs exceeds the tab bar container width.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Layout Style for a Scrollable TabBar
examples.description: This example implements the ScrollableBarModeOptions parameter of barMode. This parameter is effective only in Scrollable mode.

examples.title: Example 3: Implementing Custom Tab Switching Synchronization
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use onAnimationStart and onChange to implement synchronized switching between the tab bar and tab content.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Basic Attributes of the Divider
examples.description: This example uses divider to present dividers in different styles.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting Tab Bar Fading
examples.description: This example uses fadingEdge to enable or disable the fading effect when switching tabs.

examples.title: Example 6: Implementing TabBar Overlay on TabContent
examples.description: This example shows how to use barOverlap to specify whether the tab bar overlaps the TabContent component with a blurred background effect.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting the Visible Area for the Tab Bar in Responsive Grid Mode
examples.description: This example uses barGridAlign to set the visible area of the tab bar in responsive grid mode.

examples.title: Example 8: Implementing a Custom Tab Switching Animation
examples.description: This example uses customContentTransition to implement a custom tab switching animation.

examples.title: Example 9: Implementing Tab Switching Interception
examples.description: This example uses onContentWillChange to implement custom swipe-based tab switching interception.

examples.title: Example 10: Customizing the Tab Switching Animation
examples.description: This example uses onChange, onAnimationStart, onAnimationEnd, and onGestureSwipe APIs to customize the tab bar switching animation.

examples.title: Example 11: Preloading Child Nodes
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the preloadItems API to preload specified child nodes.

examples.title: Example 12: Setting Tab Bar Translation and Opacity
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the translation distance and opacity of the tab bar using the setTabBarTranslate and setTabBarOpacity APIs.

examples.title: Example 13: Implementing Lazy Loading and Resource Release of Pages
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use a custom TabBar with the Swiper component and LazyForEach to implement lazy loading and resource release of pages.

examples.title: Example 14: Implementing the Tab Switching Animation
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement a tab switching animation by setting animationMode.

examples.title: Example 15: Enabling Tabs to Exceed the Tab Bar Area
examples.description:
This example shows how to enable tabs to exceed the tab bar area by setting the clip property of the TabBar using barModifier in TabsOptions.
Starting from API version 15, the barModifier API is added to TabsOptions.

examples.title: Example 16: Aligning Tabs
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to align tabs by setting the align property of the TabBar using barModifier in TabsOptions.
Starting from API version 15, the barModifier API is added to TabsOptions.

examples.title: Example 17: Synchronizing Tabs and TabBar Synchronously
examples.description:
This example shows how to implement synchronized switching between the Tabs and TabBar components using the onSelected callback.
The onSelected API is added since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 18: Releasing the Tabs Child components
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to release the Tabs child components by setting cachedMaxCount.
The cachedMaxCount API is added since API version 19.

examples.title: Example 19: Setting the Tab Bar Background Blur Effect
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set the background blur style and effect of TabBar in barBackgroundBlurStyle and barBackgroundEffect APIs.
The barBackgroundBlurStyle and barBackgroundEffect APIs are added since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 20: Setting the Edge Sliding Effect
examples.description: This example uses edgeEffect to implement different edge rebound effects.

examples.title: Example 21: Setting the Tab Switching Animation Curve
examples.description:
This example illustrates how to set the tab switching animation curve using the animationCurve API, and how to combine it with animationDuration to set the animation duration.
The animationCurve API is added since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 22: Listening for Swipe Events on the Tabs Page
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set the callback for a Tabs component is swiped using the onContentDidScroll API.
The onContentDidScroll API is supported since API version 23.

examples.title: Example 23: Implementing Nested Scrolling of Tabs
examples.description:
This example shows how to use the nestedScroll API to set the nested scrolling effect of Tabs.
The nestedScroll API is added since API version 24.
